name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing across multiple stable and beta tracks. The latest stable release is v0.64.1 (released October 7, 2025; Enterprise: v1.64.1), with v0.65.0-beta (released October 13, 2025) available for early testing. Patch releases continue on older supported branches (v0.63.x and v0.58.x), indicating long-term support for multiple versions. Both Open Source (Docker: metabase/metabase) and Enterprise (Docker: metabase/metabase-enterprise) editions are available. Detailed per-release changelogs are linked via 'Full Changelog' on the GitHub releases page at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license (Metabase Commercial Software License)
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases across stable and beta tracks within the past month
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud (managed hosting) is available at metabase.com
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise/Pro edition
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, SQLite, MongoDB, Oracle, Presto/Trino, Druid, Google Analytics, Spark SQL, and more via drivers

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers far more advanced analytics and visualization capabilities than Metabase but is significantly more expensive and not open source.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash is a strong open-source alternative tightly integrated with dbt, making it ideal for dbt-centric teams, but it has a smaller community and fewer connectors than Metabase.
